  "questions": [
    "What is the MVP scope and which 3–5 user-critical workflows must not break?",
    "What are the top risks or compliance concerns that testing must cover (e.g., auditability, approvals, data retention, SSO)?",
    "How many engineers are on the team (any dedicated QA), and what is your target release cadence?",
    "Which external systems or services will this module integrate with in test/prod, and do you have stable test environments or fixtures for them?"
  ],
  "summary": "Starting test strategy discovery for a new module. No test approach decisions captured yet; need clarity on MVP scope, risk/compliance priorities, team size and release cadence, and integration environments to shape the testing pyramid, coverage targets, and quality gates."
}
